prompt:
Edit the supplied Architecture Story Studio cream YouTube banner. Preserve its warm ivory background, navy architectural pen drawings, subtle ochre-gold highlights, sophisticated serif title, small semicircular arch emblem and exact wording. This is a precise responsive-layout correction, not a new brand.

Output a complete 16:9 YouTube banner, preferably 2560 x 1440. CRITICAL: the desktop visible strip is only the central 29 percent of the full canvas height. ALL architecture and ALL typography must fit comfortably inside the CENTRAL 23 PERCENT HEIGHT, from y=39% to y=62%. The upper 38 percent and lower 37 percent must be empty ivory background, without any architectural details, large grid, or objects.

Scale the entire left building drawing down substantially, keep its full roof peak, complete side aisles, and foundation visible, place the COMPLETE building within x=3% to x=20%, y=40% to y=61%. Nothing cut off at canvas edge. Right bridge must be a complete compact three-span masonry arched bridge seen in slight perspective, including BOTH ends, full arches, piers, parapet and baseline, within x=80% to x=97%, y=43% to y=60%. Do not leave a bridge extending beyond the right edge. Reduce drafting guide arcs too so everything stays within the strip. Preserve the original illustration style.

The central text block stays centered, horizontally x=22% to x=78%, vertically y=43% to y=58%; shrink the emblem and gold dividers as needed. Main title, exactly: "ARCHITECTURE STORY STUDIO". Secondary italic line, exactly: "How structures work. Why they look the way they do." Keep lettering sharp, large enough and high contrast; never overlap artwork and text. Small arch icon above title. There must be visible ivory breathing room above and below all artwork inside the desktop strip.

No crop guides, no blue lines, no labels, no UI, no mockup, no additional copy, no watermark. The two buildings should read as small complete architectural illustrations flanking the title, rather than huge cropped edge decorations.
